greeting: Ataniup Aqqani, Ataataq, Irniq, Taerlu Anersaaq Salumajuq. Amen. Ataniq ilissinniiqatauli.
penitential:
Ataniq, naammagivugut.
Christ, naammagivugut.
Ataniq, naammagivugut.
psalm_response: Nunarjuaq tamatumunga piniaritsi, Nunalimaat tukisiritsi Tusaatitsillusi.
homily:
Takugitsi kinguani kaammalirutinik. Utiqtillugu uaqquaqtuq, aaniap aqqutingitigut, inuup uummatingitigut. Tusaajavut Galatians-mi uqausiinik: 'After fourteen years I again went up to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus along also.' Paul uqaqtuq aqqutinik, aqqut ungahiktumut piumanngilaq. Inuk apqutimi pisuktuq, ilani kinguiniklu qaitillugu. Takugitsi aqqut, takugitsi qanuq aqqutiqaqtilluni. Benjamin Vo qaujimajurli qanuq aqqutiqaqtilluni. Ben qaujimajurli qanuq aviation-mi, Boeing 737-mi, ammalu qanuq 'con chim airlines'-mik qajjaalauqtuq, giggles-pallalauqtuq dad-mut. Ben-up inuusia, taanna 'masterpiece-ngulluni', uummataup salumajunianik ammalu asijinik asujinik tatatitaulluni.

Kisiani, qanuq inuusiq tusaajavut Gospel-mi? Luke-mi, tusaajavut: 'Jesus was praying in a certain place, and when he had finished, one of his disciples said to him, "Lord, teach us to pray just as John taught his disciples."' Jesus-up akilauqtuq: 'Father, hallowed be your name, your Kingdom come. Give us each day our daily bread...' Takugitsi taanna uqaqtuq, takugitsi qanuq inuusiq Ataniup aqqutingitigut pisuktuq. Benjamin, taanna boy, qaujimajurli qanuq Ataniup aqqutingani pisuktuq. Ben, taanna boy, qaujimajurli qanuq dad-up stories-iinik tusaajuktuq, qanuq github repo-mi games and applications code-laurmat. Ben qaujimajurli qanuq inuusiq tunisilluni.

Alan, Thao, ammalu Ryan. Ilissiklu uqumaittumik atuqtut. Qaujimajavut uqumaittuq, qaujimajavut silataani inuusiq. Kisiani, uqaqtuq Gospel-mi, 'Father, hallowed be your name.' Ben, taanna 'Banquet of Heaven'-mi, standing beside Saint Carlo Acutis. Two brilliant, modern boys who loved technology, who loved the world, but who loved God more. They are not dead; they are more alive than we are. They are soaring in the light of the Father, free from all weight, breathing the pure air of heaven.

Maanna, qanuritlutik inuit? Ilissik uqumaittumik atuqtut, kisiani Ataniq qaninganiittuq. Qaujimajavut Benjamin-up middle name-nga, Đại Dương, Great Ocean. Taanna ocean-tut, Ataniup asannininga aniguqtilaaqtuq. Qaujimajavut qanuq Ben giggles-pallalauqtuq con chim airlines-mik. Taanna giggles, taanna smile, ilissinniiqataummijuq.

What can we carry out the door today? When your heart feels heavy, when the morning light comes in and you feel the empty chair, do not look only at the silence. Look up at the sky, just like Ben loved to watch airplanes soar, and remember that God's peace is real, God's covenant is forever, and Benjamin Vo is safe in the Father's eternal embrace.
petitions: Quyasivugut Ataniup asanniniani. Qanigijavut inuusiit uqumaittillugit, qaujimajavut Ataniq qaninganiittuq.
communion: Ataniq Jesus, qaujimajunga Illit Sacrament-mi piuniitut, asannigtunga Illinnik pigiarlutik inuusiqni. Illinni piugumavunga, kisiani maannakkut sakkuqpunga Illinni. Qaujimajunga Illit uummammut isiqquqquuqut. Asannivunga Illinnik, piunginnarniarli.
closing: Ataniup piqutaa ilissinniiqatauli, maannakkut nunarjuarmiullu tamatumuuna. Amen.
standing_petitions: Benjamin Đại Dương Vo-mut ammalu toqusimasunut tamarmik, Ataniup qaumaningani iquaniinniaqquuqut.
Uqumaittunut tamarmik, Ataniup qajuutaa asanniningalu niriunniarniqquuqut.

readings.label: Reading 1
readings.text: Brothers and sisters: After fourteen years I again went up to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus along also. I went up in accord with a revelation, and I presented to them the Gospel that I preach to the Gentiles– but privately to those of repute– so that I might not be running, or have run, in vain. On the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the Gospel to the uncircumcised, just as Peter to the circumcised, for the one who worked in Peter for an apostolate to the circumcised worked also in me for the Gentiles, and when they recognized the grace bestowed upon me, James and Cephas and John, who were reputed to be pillars, gave me and Barnabas their right hands in partnership, that we should go to the Gentiles and they to the circumcised. Only, we were to be mindful of the poor, which is the very thing I was eager to do. And when Cephas came to Antioch, I opposed him to his face because he clearly was wrong. For, until some people came from James, he used to eat with the Gentiles; but when they came, he began to draw back and separated himself, because he was afraid of the circumcised. And the rest of the Jews acted hypocritically along with him, with the result that even Barnabas was carried away by their hypocrisy. But when I saw that they were not on the right road in line with the truth of the Gospel, I said to Cephas in front of all, "If you, though a Jew, are living like a Gentile and not like a Jew, how can you compel the Gentiles to live like Jews?"

readings.label: Responsorial Psalm
readings.text: R. Go out to all the world, and tell the Good News. Praise the LORD, all you nations, glorify him, all you peoples! R. Go out to all the world, and tell the Good News. For steadfast is his kindness toward us, and the fidelity of the LORD endures forever. R. Go out to all the world, and tell the Good News.

readings.label: Gospel
readings.text: Jesus was praying in a certain place, and when he had finished, one of his disciples said to him, "Lord, teach us to pray just as John taught his disciples." He said to them, "When you pray, say: Father, hallowed be your name, your Kingdom come. Give us each day our daily bread and forgive us our sins for we ourselves forgive everyone in debt to us, and do not subject us to the final test."

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben
